notebook_versioning_policy.increments_for: EVERY notebook mutation, including minor fixes, comments, markdown edits, metadata or typos
notebook_versioning_policy.ordering: Copy original exact bytes to numbered PRE archive; read back before editing original; update current revision in-place; POST readback + CI; append ledger and publish.
notebook_versioning_policy.no_drive_file_id_claim: The provided URL is GitHub-backed; it has no verified Google Drive file ID.
notebook_versioning_policy.archive_promotion: Do not reassign a previous archival path/name or overwrite its contents. Retrospective historical source creation dates must be distinguished from archive copy date.
progress_requirements: live source-by-source preflight with exact NPT windows, source names, IDs and parent associations
operator COLLECT confirmation before private Drive archive writes

partial_capture_evidence.cause_known: Original CDN url returns JPEG bytes with HTTP Content-Length matching observed count, but many attachments differ from Discord attachment size metadata; identity encoding did not change this.
partial_capture_evidence.next_gate: Operator: C01 then C02 transparent preview; type COLLECT after validating the live roster and NPT cutoffs; inspect new frozen C02 receipt, then C05 private index. Old 749 mismatch debt stays PARTIAL.

cell_reference_ids.name: SETUP
cell_reference_ids.definition: Google Drive authorization and Discord credential, six visible stage markers

cell_reference_ids.name: COLLECTOR
cell_reference_ids.definition: Read-only live preflight of parents/active child threads and per-source NPT scan windows; confirmed Discord/Drive collection and frozen receipt only after operator types COLLECT.

cell_reference_ids.name: CDN PROBE
cell_reference_ids.definition: Read-only one-failed-attachment source/proxy byte and dimensions comparison; no Drive writes or cursor changes

cell_reference_ids.name: DAILY INDEX
cell_reference_ids.definition: Reads new C02 immutable receipt, verifies original raw/candidate JSONL SHA, writes private pointer-only date-partitioned JSONL and immutable manifest without touching high-water cursors.

cell_reference_ids.name: FULL HISTORY
cell_reference_ids.definition: Resumable full guild accessible-message backfill; all discoverable active/archived threads; immutable gzip JSONL pages with SHA-256, independent history cursor and explicit gaps

cell_reference_ids.name: ORIGINAL MEDIA REPAIR
cell_reference_ids.definition: Targeted retry of failed/deferred originals by Discord message/attachment ID, immutable recovery receipts

cell_reference_ids.name: PRIVATE SQLITE
cell_reference_ids.definition: Readback verified JSONL to indexed private SQLite query snapshot; preserves raw source as authority

cell_reference_ids.name: PUBLICATION GATE
cell_reference_ids.definition: Fail-closed source completion/original media/query integrity validation; data-ready only, never self-publishes

formats.role: Source-granular, normalized append-only event exchange; preserve provider message revisions and deletions, never fabricated.
PDF, DWG, SKP, E2K, photos and message attachments; retain provider identity, copy lineage and byte-integrity evidence.
Account, workspace, channel, thread, file, cursor, revision, source/destination IDs, MIME, checksums, failure states and run PRE/POST/ACK.
Optional columnar analytical projection from verified JSONL; not a new authority.
Rebuildable fast indexed lookup, FK joins, corrections, and field/company/project query surfaces.
Versioned historical ranges stored with reversible decompression; preserve byte-identical original recoverability and hash manifest.
Provider envelope, project/company PK/FK, evidence status, provenance, typed material and readiness state, and validation rules.

rules: Original provider evidence in gated Drive, not in the public GitHub repository.
Public website shows public-safe reconciled facts and authorized Drive links only; Drive permissions remain the access control.
One canonical raw provider event ID and immutable correction chain; derived indexes must not duplicate source transactions.
Unknown remains unknown; stock, delivered, ordered and consumed are distinct; a photograph is not proof of DONE.
Incomplete archived-thread coverage, missing attachments, unverified bytes and provider cursor gaps remain explicitly partial.
Parquet, DuckDB and compressed partitions are future-optional derived artifacts, not already-deployed features.
PRE / POST / ACK, stable file IDs, SHA checks when available, and provider readback are required for governed mutations.
